subject: [PATCH v3 07/14] SUNRPC: stop svc_register() once rpcbind stops answering

2026-08-28.patch_summary: This patch modifies the svc_register() function in the SUNRPC module to stop registering programs and versions when the local rpcbind client times out, rather than continuing to try other programs and versions. This change is intended to prevent unnecessary delays and improve performance. The patch achieves this by adding a check for no response from the rpcbind client and breaking out of the program loop if it occurs.
